annotations.title: The greatest club-seasons within a league

description: Returns club-seasons ranked within one league since 2010/11 (or the league's first season in 442ball's record) on league results, with each side's score, its rank in the league, its longest unbeaten run and the club page URL. One league (its slug from resolve), 1 to 20 of them (default 10); or one club's best seasons (its club slug), 1 to 10, each with its league and its rank there. Finished seasons only; sides are never compared across leagues.
name: greatest_sides
title: The greatest club-seasons within a league
